title: VDBE index-record rowid extraction and prefix comparison

scope.rationale: sqlite3VdbeIdxRowid and sqlite3VdbeIdxKeyCompare acquire untrusted encoded index records, validate/decode the final integer rowid or compare the prefix against an unpacked key, and release temporary payload ownership on every post-read path.

external_source_responsibilities: Valid Btree cursor and complete payload acquisition into temporary Mem
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete source body is assigned. The current Zig candidate consumes an already-borrowed record slice and awaits source-layout cursor/payload ownership review before translation promotion.

inputs: Database connection, valid Btree index cursor, and rowid output
outputs: OK with decoded rowid, cursor/payload error, or CORRUPT for malformed header/final serial value
contracts.ownership: Cursor is borrowed; temporary full-record Mem allocation is released on success and corruption.
contracts.state_and_results: Header size must be 3 through record length. Final header serial type must be integer 1 through 9 excluding 7, and its payload must fit at the record tail.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns Btree cursor locks. One full payload read may perform pager I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Payload errors propagate. Malformed records return CORRUPT after cleanup without publishing rowid.

representation_differences: The current Zig candidate receives a bounded encoded-record slice after payload acquisition and therefore does not yet own source temporary-Mem allocation or cursor errors.
It validates all fields through a record cursor rather than reading the final header serial varint directly.

oracle.protocol: Promotion requires a pinned-C/Zig matrix over valid integer serial types 1-6/8/9, malformed header sizes, forbidden serial types, truncated rowid payloads, payload errors, and cleanup state.
internal_observations: temporary payload ownership and unchanged output on failure
oracle.normalization: Cursor transport may be normalized to exact payload bytes only after payload error and cleanup behavior is separately retained.

assurance.oom: Temporary payload allocation failure remains unverified against the slice candidate.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Btree payload error/lock behavior remains pending.
assurance.malformed_input: All source corruption branches are inventoried; exact differential is pending.
assurance.continuation: Output preservation and cleanup on failure remain pending.
assurance.performance: Source reads one complete index record; candidate walks all serial fields.

integration.native_call_path: A bounded slice-based opcode path exists, but source cursor/payload ownership and differential promotion are open.

independent_review.notes: Requires source translation, payload/cursor trace, integration assurance, and independent review.

known_blockers: Retain exact Btree payload error and temporary Mem cleanup behavior.
Run pinned-C malformed and integer-serial differential.
Decide direct-final-field versus full-slice traversal only from evidence.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/vdbeaux.c:5179-5300 was reviewed completely for cursor assumptions, payload acquisition, header and serial validation, integer decode, unpacked-prefix comparison, cleanup, and returns
src/core/internal/record_compare.zig indexRowid/Cursor and src/core/vdbe.zig opcode caller were reviewed as the current bounded candidate
callers: OP_IdxRowid execution reads the table rowid from the current index entry
Current Zig Vm opcode passes an encoded payload slice
callees: Btree payload size and MemFromBtree acquire the source record
bounded varint/header logic and sqlite3VdbeSerialGet decode the final integer
assertions_branches_cleanup: All 23 active behavior IDs cover cursor/payload assumptions, invalid payload sizes, payload errors, header bounds, integer serial whitelist, payload fit, prefix comparison, success, cleanup label, and corruption
Rowid is published only after complete validation
Temporary payload ownership is released on success and all post-read corruption paths
upstream_tests: Upstream index, corrupt, rowid, VDBE, payload, OOM, and cursor tests cover the source owner
Project btree/VDBE tests exercise the slice candidate but do not yet constitute an exact source trace
